item.zangetsu.asauchi.desc:
§7A blank soul sword awaiting its wielder.
§bArrange 3x3 White Carpets and crouch (Shift) on them for 3 seconds to begin Jinzen.
item.zangetsu.zangetsu_shikai.desc:
§6Shikai Form
§f[Right-Click] §bGetsuga Tenshō
§f[Shift + Right-Click] §bMonumental Charged Getsuga
§f[X] §eShunpo (Flash Step)
§f[R] §eToggle Slash (Horizontal / Vertical)
§f[B] §cRelease BANKAI
item.zangetsu.hollow_zangetsu.desc: §fThe inverted blade wielded by the Inner Hollow.
item.zangetsu.tensa_zangetsu.desc:
§4Bankai Form
§f[Right-Click] §8Kuroi Getsuga Tenshō (Hold to Charge)
§f[X] §eShunpo (Flash Step)
§f[R] §eToggle Slash (Horizontal / Vertical)
§f[V] §cGetsuga Melee Infusion
§f[B] §7Revert to Shikai
message.zangetsu.trial_failed: §cYour spirit was overwhelmed... Return to your body and train further.
message.zangetsu.trial_start: §f[Inner Zangetsu] §c"Let's see who is the horse and who is the king!"
message.zangetsu.trial_victory: §f[Inner Zangetsu] §a"Heh... not bad. I recognize you as my master. Take it... ZANGETSU!"
message.zangetsu.wrong_place: §7The spiritual pressure here is too calm. Perform the ritual in the Nether's Soul Sand Valley.
